posting.title: 🤖 Forget The Codex Desktop App, Use This Free One
posting.caption: Forget the Codex desktop app. Use this free one instead. It's T3 Code, MIT licensed, with over thirty-five thousand stars. One control surface for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more. It works with the subscriptions you already pay for, no new bill. Then steer your agents from desktop, web, or your phone. What are they selling? Nothing. Comment the word 'AGENTS' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.
posting.linkedin:
🤖 How many apps are you juggling just to steer your coding agents?

Claude Code here, Cursor there, Codex in another tab, each with its own window and its own habits.

T3 Code is a free, MIT-licensed control surface that puts them all in one place:

✅ Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build and Google Antigravity
✅ Uses the subscriptions you already pay for, no new bill
✅ Control your agents from a desktop app, a web app, or your phone
✅ Fully open and forkable, built to be performant and remote-ready
✅ The README literally says "Wait, what are you selling me?" Answer: "Nothing."

35,340 GitHub stars. 8,772 forks. Still very early, so expect some bugs.

Install: curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh

Would you trust one control surface to run all your agents? 👇
